title: SkillFrontmatter
description: YAML front-matter of a skill's SKILL.md (FR-046, ADR-067, docs/08 §4). Only name and description enter the injected catalog; the body loads on a slash command, a mention or auto-selection. Unknown keys from the open folder format (for example license, metadata) are preserved and ignored.

description.description: What the skill does and when to use it. The validator warns under 20 characters.

model_hint.description: Reasoning or model preference, applied within the user's model settings.

tools.description: Restricts the tools available while the skill is active; those tools are always loaded (FR-196). Never widens policy.
